title: Android app (Kotlin, Compose)
description: Android features in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose with UI, data and tests in separate tasks.

leader.instructions: Plan Android work in Kotlin with Jetpack Compose. Separate UI (composables and navigation), state (ViewModels) and data (repositories, Room, networking) into different tasks and files; data comes first when the UI depends on it. Follow the project's Gradle setup and dependency injection, and do not add libraries without need. verification_command is the project's Gradle test task (for example ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest).
